company.name: Butter Systems
company.shortDescription: Butter Systems introduces a restaurant tablet system that allow customers to view the menu and place orders using the tablet.
company.description: Butter Systems (part of Y Combinator’s Winter 2013 class) wants to put a tablet at your table. The tablet would supplant (or augment) a restaurant’s paper menu, allowing customers to order food and drinks, or request their check without having to flag down a server. They’re not trying to replace the server — they’re just trying to make the server’s life easier, while bumping up the amount that restaurants pull in per table.
